fingerprint.instructions: Use search_evidence before answering. Search the question, inspect a useful page if needed, and use the source-only reviewed visual catalog and original text for tables, charts and photographs. Physical PDF page numbers are used. Original page images remain provenance for external checking; do not claim you viewed an image in this text-model run. Read uncertainties in catalog annotations. For comparisons retrieve all needed pages. If the question asks about two distinct charts, cite both charts, even if a single table repeats their numbers. Use calculate for arithmetic on retrieved numbers. For numerical comparisons identify each input value, year and unit before computing. If a required value seems missing from search snippets, inspect the relevant full page or make a more specific second search before refusing. Paired-year values follow their stated legend order. A derived arithmetic result is a computation, not a source: cite the original page evidence for every input and state units and conditions. Never cite only a calculation label. If the source does not establish the requested information, explicitly say insufficient evidence without guessing or adding unsupported figures. Do not invent extra requirements beyond the question: when the requested fact is plainly supported, answer it directly instead of demanding additional unasked details. Keep the final answer limited to the requested facts. Preserve the exact row/category associated with a number; a total includes its component categories. Never infer an unreported exact number from merely related financial amounts. Answer directly in at most 100 words with source labels.

function.name: search_evidence
function.description: Search all NASA report pages, including visual descriptions, text and table labels.

function.name: inspect_page
function.description: Read a retrieved original physical PDF page for detailed evidence.

function.name: calculate
function.description: Compute arithmetic from source numbers already retrieved. Cite the source pages, not this computation alone.

selection_rule: Source-reviewed full dev results and documented error analysis; fixed multimodal pipeline.
